title: Basic Scene Setup
description: Minimal code to create a Three.js scene, camera, and renderer.
explanation_md: Every Three.js application needs a Scene (to hold objects), a Camera (to view them), and a Renderer (to draw them on screen).

title: Animated Rotating Cube
description: Creating a mesh and animating its rotation in a loop.
explanation_md: Shows how to create a simple geometry and material, combine them into a Mesh, and update its properties within an animation loop.

title: Responsive Window Resize
description: Adjusting the renderer and camera when the window size changes.
explanation_md: Ensures that the 3D scene doesn't look stretched or pixelated when the user resizes their browser window.

title: Load GLTF Model
description: Using GLTFLoader to import external 3D models.
explanation_md: GLTF is the standard format for 3D models on the web. The GLTFLoader handles fetching and parsing these files for use in Three.js.

title: Custom Shader Material
description: Creating a material with custom Vertex and Fragment shaders.
explanation_md: ShaderMaterial allows you to write custom GLSL code to control exactly how your objects are rendered at the pixel level.
